input_kind: real recorded RGB/depth; external motion-capture poses

dataset_attribution.publication: A Benchmark for the Evaluation of RGB-D SLAM Systems, IROS 2012
dataset_attribution.changes: selected frames; exact pixel-stride sampling; nearest RGB association; interpolated, first-camera-anchored GL pose coordinates; binary packaging

selection.method: rounded linspace over accepted pair indices; includes first and last accepted pair when frames>1
selection.spatial_resampling: raw[v*stride,u*stride], top-left row order; no interpolation

image.calibration_qualification: ROS default pinhole intrinsics recommended by TUM for pre-registered depth; not an exact distortion model

coordinates.camera: x right, y up, negative z forward
coordinates.world: initial depth camera GL basis; origin at its optical center
coordinates.pose_storage: 16 IEEE754 float32, column-major camera-to-world; original timestamp float64

pose_usage.qualification: Supplied poses position the observations; no independent trajectory accuracy or surface-ground-truth claim.

usage.role: reconstruction input with externally supplied poses
